_doc: Which trades sell to the better-off (docs/CITY_DATA.md). need = how much household income, in multiples of the reference median wage and before the price position, a household needs to buy this regularly (everyday goods 0, a luxury boutique 1.4, a new car 2.2). lean = how strongly the number of potential customers follows the share of households that can afford it: demand x (share in the city / share in the country) ^ lean. Trades not listed are everyday trades: only the city's size counts for them.
